Title: The Burning Bush
DateApprox: c. 1446 BC or c. 1270 BC (date debated by tradition)
Events: While shepherding in Midian, Moses sees a bush burning without being consumed, and God calls to him from it, revealing himself as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob and commissioning Moses to bring Israel out of Egypt. Moses objects that he is not able, and God gives him signs and promises Aaron's help.
